title: NSA personnel attend Ramsay lecture

tellings.quote: We similarly had something like that happen in Baltimore too

plain: People from the NSA, the US signals intelligence agency, came to a talk given by Scott Ramsey in Baltimore, Maryland, according to Ramsey himself. Ramsey, who appears on an episode about a reported crash with alien bodies, mentions it only in passing, saying "we similarly had something like that happen in Baltimore too." He offers it as a sign that intelligence people follow his work.
